Laravel application; expert in: laravel/fortify v1, laravel/framework v12, laravel/prompts v0, laravel/socialite v5, livewire/flux v2 (free), livewire/livewire v4, laravel/boost v2, laravel/mcp v0, laravel/pail v1, laravel/pint v1, laravel/sail v1, pestphp/pest v4, phpunit/phpunit v12.

Activate the relevant skill whenever working in its domain—don't wait until you're stuck:
- `fluxui-development`: Flux/UI components, forms, inputs, and related user requests.
- `livewire-development`: Livewire components, directives, reactivity, debugging, or tests.
- `pest-testing`: tests, assertions, coverage, test failures, or verification.
- `tailwindcss-development`: styling, Tailwind, or visual/UI changes.
- `developing-with-fortify`: authentication features and Fortify.

Follow existing code conventions; check sibling files for structure, approach, and naming. Use descriptive names and reuse existing components. Do not create verification scripts or tinker when tests cover functionality. Stick to existing directories; don't create base folders without approval. Do not change dependencies without approval. Create documentation only if explicitly requested. Be concise. If frontend changes aren't reflected, ask the user whether they need `npm run build`, `npm run dev`, or `composer run dev`.

Use Boost tools. Use `list-artisan-commands` to check Artisan options; `get-absolute-url` for project URLs; `tinker` for PHP debugging/Eloquent queries; `database-query` for read-only database access; `database-schema` before migrations/models; and `browser-logs` for recent browser logs only. Use `search-docs` before code changes for version-specific Laravel/ecosystem guidance; always use it for Laravel, Pest, Tailwind, and Fortify docs. Use multiple broad, simple topic queries; don't include package names. Query syntax: words auto-stem; multiple words use AND; quotes mean exact phrase; mixed terms combine; multiple queries use ANY.

Code rules:
- Always use curly braces, even for one-line control structures.
- Use PHP 8 constructor property promotion; do not allow empty `__construct()` methods with zero parameters unless private.
- Always declare explicit return types and type-hint parameters.
- Enum keys typically use TitleCase.
- Prefer PHPDoc over inline comments. Never use comments within the code itself unless logic is exceptionally complex.
- Add useful array-shape PHPDoc where appropriate.
- Every change must be programmatically tested: add/update a test and run affected tests. Minimize test scope; use `php artisan test --compact` with a specific filename or filter.

Laravel:
- Create files with `php artisan make:` commands; use `php artisan make:class` for generic PHP classes. Pass `--no-interaction` to all Artisan commands and correct `--options`.
- Prefer typed Eloquent relationships and ORM over raw queries, joins, or `DB::`; use query builder for very complex operations. Eager-load to prevent N+1s.
- New models need useful factories and seeders. Ask if the user needs anything else; check `php artisan make:model` options via `list-artisan-commands`.
- APIs default to versioned Eloquent API Resources unless existing routes differ; follow existing conventions.
- Always create Form Requests for validation, including rules and custom messages; check sibling requests for array/string rule style.
- Use Laravel auth/authorization (gates, policies, Sanctum, etc.).
- Prefer named routes and `route()` for links. Use `ShouldQueue` jobs for time-consuming operations.
- Environment variables only in config files; never use `env()` elsewhere. Use `config('app.name')`, not `env('APP_NAME')`.
- Tests should use factories and existing factory states; follow project Faker conventions (`$this->faker` or `fake()`).
- Create tests with `php artisan make:test [options] {name}`; pass `--unit` for unit tests. Most tests should be feature tests.
- On `Illuminate\Foundation\ViteException: Unable to locate file in Vite manifest`, run `npm run build` or ask the user to run `npm run dev` or `composer run dev`.
- Laravel 11+ streamlined structure applies. Laravel 12 middleware, exceptions, and routing are configured in `bootstrap/app.php`; providers in `bootstrap/providers.php`. No `app/Http/Kernel.php` or `app\Console\Kernel.php`; use `bootstrap/app.php` or `routes/console.php`. Commands in `app/Console/Commands/` auto-register.
- When modifying a column, preserve all existing attributes in the migration.
- Laravel 12 supports native eager-load limits: `$query->latest()->limit(10);`.
- Prefer model `casts()` over `$casts` when consistent with sibling models.

Flux: Use `<flux:*>` components when available; this is the official Livewire library. Free edition excludes Pro components.

Livewire: Use Alpine.js only when client-side interaction is needed; state is server-side. Validate and authorize in actions.

Pint: Before finalizing, run `vendor/bin/pint --dirty --format agent`. Do not run `vendor/bin/pint --test --format agent`; run `vendor/bin/pint --format agent` to fix formatting.

Pest: Create tests with `php artisan make:test --pest {name}`. Run `php artisan test --compact` or `php artisan test --compact --filter=testName`. Do NOT delete tests without approval. Always use `search-docs` for version-specific Pest guidance.

Tailwind: Follow existing conventions. Always use `search-docs` for version-specific Tailwind guidance; never rely on training data.
